estimate_note: Prior separate T4 development smoke runs took about 120s (MEND) and 132s (FT), each including model loading. A shared load near 100s plus a 20-40s episode is an uncertain planning guess, not a measured pipeline estimate or promise; use this profile's timings.
stopping_condition: One fixed train-row0 episode; 25 queries, one MEND edit and one 15-step FT edit; exact rollback required
success_rule: All 25 calls executed and exact rollback; abstentions and wrong answers are measured outcomes

adaptations: Only selected weights have FP32 master copies; released base dtypes retained
Evaluation mode retained instead of upstream training mode
Context-aligned labels replace released standalone-label convention

resources.limits: RSS sampling can miss short spikes; CUDA allocator figures do not include every driver allocation. These are diagnostic-run resources, not a serving latency benchmark.

adaptations: Selective namespace imports bypass unrelated EasyEdit package initializers
Same custom OPT class/weights/dtypes; low_cpu_mem_usage changes loading allocation
Loaded FP32 EVA encoder and normalization move to CUDA before Q-Former/OPT construction after observed host-RAM exhaustion; final weights and computation are unchanged
Original MEND loss/hooks/learned transforms; skip functional mutation tail and apply factors once in FP32 on the selected device
Evaluation mode freezes dropout and MEND normalization; no auxiliary-model training
Default release labels match CaptionDataset rather than the differing executor; optional context-aligned suffix labels are explicitly marked experimental
Target-free bounded cached greedy continuation, rather than teacher-forced benchmark prediction
Single patch stores original/edited tensors for exact rollback and reload
